description: Bullet Chart Visual (Performance Tracking KPI Visual) The Bullet Chart Visual is a compact and powerful Power BI visual designed to compare Actual performance vs Target in a clean and space-efficient way. It is ideal for KPI tracking, performance measurement, and target monitoring across any department or business scenario. The visual displays a bold performance bar (Actual), a clear marker line (Target), and colored background ranges such as Poor, Average, and Good. This helps users quickly understand how well they are performing and where improvements are needed. Key Features: 📊 Actual vs Target comparison: View the actual performance value against the defined target 🎨 Colored performance zones: Highlight Poor, Average, and Good ranges using background colors 📍 Clear target line: A vertical marker line shows whether performance is below or above the target 📏 Fully customizable: Adjust bar width, colors, thresholds, and display settings 🔄 Horizontal & vertical modes: Display the chart in either direction based on design needs 🧮 Supports multiple data fields: Category, Actual, Target, Min, Max, and Threshold values 🔍 Interactive tooltips: Explore exact values for deeper insights 📌 Filter responsive: Works smoothly with Power BI slicers & filters Who Benefits from This Visual? 👥 Finance teams tracking budget vs actual spending 👥 Sales managers monitoring sales targets…
